svg.title: How the mean resultant length R̄ is calculated
svg.desc: Spawning records become arrows on a lunar circle. The means of their cosines and sines give an average arrow, and its length is R̄. The loop shows Raffles Lighthouse, Akajima, Eilat and a made-up example with two opposite groups.
svg.text: d is the day counted from full moon

g.text: The arrows agree, so little cancels
Most arrows agree, a few pull away
Arrows point all round and cancel
